articles.title: Why Neeraj Chopra's CWG 2026 silver means more with Yashvir Singh by his side
articles.description: Neeraj Chopra secured a silver medal in the javelin throw at the Commonwealth Games.  He shared the podium with fellow Indian Yashvir Singh, who won bronze.  Yashvir achieved a personal best throw on his final attempt to claim the medal.  Chopra expressed happiness at sharing the podium with another Indian athlete.  This silver medal adds to Chopra's extensive collection of career achievements.

articles.title: Wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara dies by suicide
articles.description: Muskan Balhara, wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara, died by suicide Friday. Her family members are alleging harassment and staged a protest outside their residence. Police are investigating the incident and recording statements from family members. A forensic team has inspected the house and collected evidence for the ongoing inquiry. Muskan and Sheelu were married in December 2023 and have a young son.

articles.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke questioned an FIR against a woman for abusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi. articles.title: Judoka Asmita Dey breaks down recalling late father after winning CWG gold
articles.description: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a dramatic women's 48kg final match. This victory fulfilled a dream she feared was lost after her father's death. Her father had always supported her aspirations and encouraged her to dream big. Dey credited the support from SAI Bhopal for her continued progress.

articles.title: Shareholders approve issue of warrants to promoter group entity
articles.description: Zee shareholders approved convertible warrants for promoters, raising over three thousand crore rupees. This approval allows promoters to increase their stake significantly in the company. Institutional shareholders largely opposed the resolution, while non-institutional investors provided strong backing. The company also gained approval for its employee stock option plan for eligible staff. This outcome reverses a previous shareholder rejection of a similar funding proposal.

articles.title: TISS postpones 86th convocation citing 'unforeseen circumstances'; CJI Surya Kant was to be chief guest
articles.description: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences abruptly postponed its 86th annual convocation on Sunday, August 2. Students who had traveled to Mumbai faced significant financial losses due to the sudden cancellation. The institute cited unforeseen circumstances for the postponement in a late-night email to graduating students. Many students expressed frustration over the last-minute communication and incurred travel expenses.
